amendments.summary: RMSE co-primary; DB-MAPE guardrail; BatteryLife paper baselines as reference set with local reproductions; Phase 1 = most accurate model (no efficiency-first track); budget raised
Development room: promising directions get up to 3 evidence-led follow-ups; close after 4 consecutive DISCARDs; non-promising get one repair (program.md §7)
Phase 2 (and later Phase 3) unlock when the previous phase closes by target OR no-gain stop/hard limit; best 3-seed-confirmed model frozen; TARGET_NOT_MET recorded

seen/unseen-condition metric; Phase-1 focus on unseen-condition generalization (D1 SOC-window-aware view, D2 reference-pair, D3 learned-shape head); paper baselines reduced to CPTransformer + CPGRU as reference
New project v5_auto on NA-ion, same workflow as v4_auto; 3 paper splits (2021/42/2024) reported as mean ± std; runs on remote GPU (Kaggle/Colab); all three agents work together on this project.
Epochs: max 100, min 5, patience 5 after epoch 5 (paper CPMLP.sh); the Li-ion 15-epoch cap does not apply.

Target: Na-ion MAPE below the BatteryLife paper CPMLP Na-ion MAPE (0.274 ± 0.026, paper test, 3 splits). Final claim uses the 3-split test MAPE once at the end; during search, models must also beat our CPMLP val baseline 0.1778 ± 0.0539.

No local reproduction of BatteryLife paper baselines (program.md 2b skipped): the paper's Na-ion numbers are the reference (CPMLP 0.274, CPTransformer 0.255 test MAPE). Go straight to own architectures; the local CPMLP 3-split run stays as the matched val reference.

amendments.summary: After NA-E026 missed its split-2021 law gate by 0.0013 (excess -25.8% vs -30%), the identical NA-E026 config is confirmed on splits 42 and 2024. Decision rule fixed BEFORE these runs: KEEP the degradation-law loss only if (i) the 3-split mean MAPE is <= parent 0.1087 + 0.005 and (ii) the 3-split mean held-out law-fit excess over the true-EOL floor falls >= 30% vs the parent's 3-split mean excess, and (iii) balance PASS on every split. Reported transparently as an amendment, not as the original pre-registration.

Main-loss ablation: train the best Na model (NA-E009 config) with MSE on the standardised EOL (the paper's CPMLP loss) instead of Relative Huber, 3 splits (NA-E029/E030/E031), no physics term, to measure how MAPE changes. Diagnostic only; it cannot replace the frozen model unless the user decides.
